title: US voters head to polls for midterm elections set to define remainder of Trump's term
summary: The crucial midterms will determine how much power President Donald Trump has to make changes in the last two years of his term.

image.caption: Many US voters cast their ballots in early voting ahead of the midterm electionsImage: AM Stewart/AFP

blocks.text: US midterms: Americans vote in polls seen as referendum on Trump
The crucial midterms will determine how much power President Donald Trump has to make changes in the last two years of his term.
